verdict.rationale: Omarchy installs from an ISO written to a USB stick: you answer five questions and get a finished desktop, with mandatory full-disk encryption (docs-41, docs-14). Community users describe it taking over the whole machine and call the install uncomplicated (comm-14, comm-7). missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on choosing and wiping the existing OS disk, and any guidance on migrating data from the previous OS.
